I have started running the test suite in the container and am waiting for it to finish.
I have implemented `Encode` and `Decode` on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go#L430-L469) on branch `shapeindex-encode`.

### Summary of Changes
- **Serialization (`Encode` & `Decode`)**:
  - Added [`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go#L1189-L1196) and [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go#L1199-L1206) in [s2/shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go).
  - Automatically builds unbuilt indexes during `Encode` so decoded indexes always have a complete spatial cell structure (`cells`, `cellMap`, `ShapeIndexCell`, `clippedShape`s, `containsCenter`, and `edges`) with `status = fresh`, enabling queries and iteration immediately without calling `Build()`.
  - Round-trips all built-in `Shape` implementations (`*Polygon`, `*Polyline`, `*PointVector`, `*LaxPolyline`, `*LaxPolygon`, `*Loop`, `*LaxLoop`) as well as generic `Shape` implementations, preserving exact shape IDs (including non-contiguous IDs after removals), zero-edge shapes, and mixed chain counts.
  - Validates encoded version, cell ordering/disjointness, shape/edge references, finite coordinates, allocation bounds (capping initial slice/map capacity before reading stream elements to prevent OOM panics on oversized length prefixes), and a trailing CRC32 checksum.
- **Shape & Index Fixes**:
  - Updated [`ShapeIndex.applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go#L720-L760), [`ShapeIndex.makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go#L880-L971), and [`ShapeIndex.Reset`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go#L597-L607) in [s2/shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex.go) to handle non-contiguous shape IDs when shapes are removed.
  - Fixed chain/decode handling in [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/lax_loop.go#L106-L113), [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/lax_polygon.go#L168-L185), [`PointVector.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/point_vector.go#L56-L58), [`Polyline.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/polyline.go#L156-L184), [`Loop.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/loop.go#L350-L398), and [`Polygon.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/polygon.go#L418-L510).
- **Tests**:
  - Added round-trip, spatial query, non-contiguous shape ID, and malformed/corrupted/truncated/oversized input tests in [s2/shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-udfj_yjw/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L618-L1052).
